title: Oil Prices Rise on Supply Concerns
content: Oil prices increased today amid ongoing concerns about supply disruptions in the Middle East.

title: New Renewable Energy Policy Announced

title: Unexpected Decline in Crude Inventories
content: Latest reports show a larger than expected drop in U.S. crude inventories, pushing prices higher.
